control.title: Vendor contracts and data processing agreements
control.description: Sign contracts with security requirements and a data processing agreement before sharing personal data with a processor, including breach notice, erasure and security safeguard obligations.

evidence_hint: Signed DPAs and security addenda for vendors handling personal data.
acceptance_criteria: Signed data processing agreements or security terms for vendors handling personal data
The agreements cover security, breach notification and deletion

criteria_coverage.criterion: Signed data processing agreements or security terms for vendors handling personal data
The agreements cover security, breach notification and deletion

requirements.title: Extend controls to ecosystem partners
requirements.guidance: Make unregulated entities in your payment chain (payment gateways, technology providers, vendors) follow these Directions through agreements and a Board-approved policy.

requirements.title: Engage processors only under a valid contract
requirements.guidance: Engage a Data Processor only under a valid contract, and only to provide goods or services to Data Principals.

requirements.title: Vendor and partner risk
requirements.guidance: Assess and manage risks from vendors and business partners.

requirements.title: Security safeguards in processor contracts
requirements.guidance: Include provisions in contracts with Data Processors requiring them to take reasonable security safeguards.

requirements.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
requirements.guidance: Agree security requirements with each supplier in contracts.

requirements.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
requirements.guidance: Manage security risks in the ICT product and service supply chain.
